summary.text: Susan Johnson has served Windham residents in the Connecticut General Assembly since January 2009, representing the 49th House District, and is a Deputy Majority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Before joining the legislature, she served three terms as a selectman for the Town of Windham.

She graduated from Eastern Connecticut State University and Western New England College School of Law, and worked for nearly 20 years as an advocate for Medicare beneficiaries at Connecticut Legal Services and the Center for Medicare Advocacy.
She is a law partner in the Willimantic firm O'Brien & Johnson.
